about: Bhagwati Autocast Ltd (BAL) manufactures specialised grey /cast iron (CI) and spheroidal graphite/ductile iron (SGI) castings, primarily for Indian tractor and automobile OEMs, from its Rajoda plant near Bavla, Ahmedabad; In the FY26, its capacity was 22,800 MTPA and the company serves only the domestic market.
